page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top: page number 132 at left, running title "EMBLEMA" centred above the heading. Below the heading, a large woodcut engraving occupying the centre. Below the engraving, a verse motto of four lines in italic, centred. Catchword "In" at the lower right.

main_text.head: SINE CERERE ET BACCHO friget venus.
main_text.p: [Engraving: a tavern interior with a skeleton and a woman in the foreground, a drinking company at a table, a barrel and a figure at the back, a skeleton at a window.]
main_text.l: Αλογα habent certas potandi animantia leges,
Nos homines autem recta ratione vigentes,
Nos madidus Iacchus nocte diegq; rigat.

page.notes: The engraving is described, not transcribed. The Greek word at the start of the first verse line is copied as best read; its exact letters are uncertain. "Vltra" and "Nos" are printed as shown. The heading shows the printed words "SINE CERERE ET BACCHO" with "friget venus" on a second line. Printed "diegq;" is kept as printed.
